title: derive_column: create a new column using arithmetic on an existing column
description: Add a new column whose values are computed by applying an arithmetic operator (+, -, *, /) to an existing column and either a constant numeric value or another column. Only the four basic arithmetic operators are supported for safety. Use this when the user wants to compute a ratio, scale a column, or calculate a difference between two columns.

parameters.name: new_column
parameters.description: Name for the new derived column.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The existing column to use as the left operand. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A constant numeric value to use as the right operand. Provide either value or other_column, not both.

parameters.name: other_column
parameters.description: An existing column to use as the right operand. Provide either other_column or value, not both.

rag_note: Only +, -, *, / are supported. Do not use eval() or string expressions. Always provide exactly one of value or other_column. Division by zero will raise an ExecutionError.
